title: Frozen price-only control on the text-matched Fed/SPX validation set
question: On the Fed releases whose exact text is verified, how do the frozen price-only CNN control, persistence, DLinear and ridge compare for 20- and 30-minute SPX Close forecasts?
configuration: Frozen three-seed compact CNN from fed-spx-endpoints-price-v1 (trained on 978 price-eligible train releases; exact CUDA replay). DLinear and ridge refitted on the same 978 releases and target. Scored on the 123 text-verified validation releases (113 release instants, 105 dates) with unit weight per release instant and paired 10-date block intervals. Test not loaded.
finding: Persistence MAE was 17.707 / 22.058 bp at 20 / 30 minutes. The CNN control was 17.615 / 22.042 bp, a gain of +0.082 / -0.002 bp with intervals including zero. DLinear (18.340 / 22.736 bp) and ridge (21.027 / 26.263 bp) were worse than persistence.
limitations: Validation only. CNN checkpoint epochs were chosen on the 207 price-eligible validation rows, which contain these 123, so its validation score is optimistic. Intervals of about +/-0.3 bp mean only a text gain of roughly half a basis point or more can register. The cohort includes inferred evidence classes; the strictest-evidence subset has 27 rows. The bar clock is empirically supported.

figure.alt: Grouped bars of validation MAE at 20 and 30 minutes on 123 text-matched releases. Persistence and the price CNN control are nearly equal; DLinear is slightly higher and ridge about 3 to 4 bp higher.
